_comment: Planner web classification with a report open (dataset_id), as in the chat. Each case states the expected task_kind (web planner only), need_web and web_intent. clear=true cases must be right on every run; clear=false cases are tracked, not gating. company_news = news or events about one company; unsupported_external = macro, market, industry or price data; need_web=false = answerable from the report.
